prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A hyper-detailed close-up shot of the lower half of a middle-aged man's face, focusing intensely on his mouth, mustache, and the texture of his skin. The man has a prominent, slightly bulbous nose and a thick, salt-and-pepper mustache with individual hairs clearly visible. His lips are slightly parted, revealing his teeth, and the skin around his mouth and nose is rendered with realistic pores and subtle wrinkles, emphasizing age and character. The lighting is soft but natural, highlighting the contours and texture of the skin without harsh shadows. The background is blurred and indistinct, drawing all attention to the facial features and creating a shallow depth of field. The color palette is muted and realistic, with natural skin tones and a slight coolness to the overall image. The composition is intimate and almost confrontational, as if the viewer is standing very close to the subject, evoking a sense of tension or anticipation. The style is cinematic, reminiscent of a dramatic film close-up, with a focus on realism and emotional intensity.
